vulnerability_analysis: The DoctorShiba contract has an owner-only function transfernewun() that sets the newun variable. When newun is set to an address, that address cannot receive tokens from anyone except the owner (due to checks in _transfer() and transferFrom()). More critically, if an address already holds tokens and is set as newun, it cannot transfer those tokens out (except to the owner), effectively locking their funds. This is an owner privilege abuse where the owner can arbitrarily freeze any address's tokens.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call transfernewun() with the victim's address as parameter. This will set newun to the victim's address, satisfying the oracle check (newun == victim_address).
step_by_step_plan: 1. Identify the current owner of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call transfernewun(victimAddress) on the target contract. 4. Verify that newun() now returns victimAddress.
